alt: Light micrographs of the three muscle tissue types, top to bottom: (a) skeletal muscle - long parallel fibers with strong cross-striations and flattened nuclei at the fiber edge; (b) smooth muscle - spindle-shaped cells with a single central nucleus and no striations; (c) cardiac muscle - shorter branching fibers with central nuclei and faint striations.
